item.title: Call for Papers
item.content:encoded:
This page is dedicated to current Calls for Papers. The journal welcomes submissions within the scope of each individual call.

Submissions should be prepared according to the Author Guidelines.

The Editorial team are also inviting submissions of new special issue proposals.
